newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Security Bank rated "buy on weakness".
newsitem.headline: Security Bank rated "buy on weakness".

text.p: Security Bank Corp was rated a buy on weakness on Thursday by Asian Capital Equities Inc due to an expected surge in earnings by 1997.

"Although 1996 financial performance will be below expectations and below industry performance, a rebound is anticipated in 1997 with net income rising by 45 percent," said analyst Michelle Benedicto in an advisory to clients.

"Security Bank is a growth bank," she said, adding that the bank is aggressive in marketing its various loan products and the generation of deposits through a branch expansion programme of at least ten branches per year.

For this year, the brokerage house expects Security Bank to post a 22 percent growth in earnings per share (EPS) to 3.77 pesos from 3.09 pesos. The 1996 EPS excludes the one-time gains of 300 million pesos from a property swap with Philippine Banking Corp.
"Security Bank's performance for 1996 is a disappointment with net income of 22 percent way below that of the industry's 32 percent," Benedicto said.
The brokerage house placed 1997 EPS forecast for Security Bank at 5.46 pesos, 45 percent from the 1996 estimate.
